title: Basic Elements of Design
slide_intent: Name the elements that must work together so a reader can recognize the identity across uses.
strategic_value: A compact inventory can help CSAIL authors carry the same identifier, verbal phrase and palette into new communications.
demonstration: The right panel stacks the lockup, three-word tagline and three labeled color cards, separated by rules.
practical_value: Check whether a proposed piece uses the appropriate signature, verbal cue and colors for its audience.

content_islands.name: Introduction
content_islands.spec: Keep the purpose of the elements in a narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Identifier and tagline
content_islands.spec: Center the full lab signature above a ruled band containing the tagline.

content_islands.name: Palette
content_islands.spec: Place rust, gold and gray swatches in a single row beneath the second rule. Label each with its Pantone reference.
